definition.simple: An atom is like a single LEGO block. It is the smallest piece of everything around us.
definition.academic: An atom is the smallest particle of an element that can exist and retain all the chemical properties of that element.

examples: A single gold atom in a gold ring.
An oxygen atom in the air we breathe.

common_misconceptions: Atoms of different elements look exactly the same.
Atoms can be seen with a normal microscope.
ai_context.tutor_hint: If a student asks how small an atom is, tell them there are more atoms in a single drop of water than there are drops of water in all the oceans of the world.
